_comment: Apple Reminders routing for scripts/engram_tasks.py (apply_config documents every key). domain_to_list keys must be domains in domains.json; a waiting_on row goes to '<owned list><waiting_suffix>'. entity_rules: [{"list": "<an entity's own list>", "pattern": "<case-insensitive regex>"}] for finance tasks that belong to one entity. never_write: lists engram must never create a reminder in (e.g. an hours or billing log). extra_lists: hand-managed lists to include in the reconcile read scope.
